_readme: Site lighting inventory, operator 2026-10-01/02. Main lot: 5 double poles — two in front of Units 105/107 (islands at plan x 385), two in the islands further down (plan x 913), and one at the front corner of Jason's by the 149 walkway — positions marked by the operator on the A-8 night render 2026-10-02. The register's 2006 corner luminaire (light-pole-corner, Arnould × Patricia) is not among the five and is not drawn (`suppressRegister`). Lot 7: one double pole on the far edge, 3/4 of the way across from the right. Lot 8: 4 building-mounted lights, 2 on each wall that faces the lot (the 135A/135B north wall and the 133 east end wall). A fixture on every walkway column; the two corner columns (101 Johnston corner, 149 Arnould corner) carry two, one per open face. Walkway downlights in one line down the center. Points are A-1 plan px and approximate to within an island / a few feet.
